title: Add the exact slide counter and npm script
description:
## Objective
A script that loads the deck through @slidev/parser, follows src: imports, prints the count and every title, and fails outside 15-20.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-foundation/2026-08-13-deck-foundation-spec.md` — Section: "3. Write count-slides.mjs"

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/scripts/count-slides.mjs` (create), `slides/package.json` (add 'slides' script)

## Implementation
1. Import { load } from '@slidev/parser/fs'. Signature is load(rootsInfo, filepath) — the one-arg form throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE.
2. Resolve root as the parent of scripts/.
3. Print 'slides: N' then a numbered title list. Title falls back to the first line of slide.content.
4. process.exit(1) if N < 15 or N > 20.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run slides`
Must report 19 and exit 0. Do NOT close until it does.
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run slides reports 19 slides and exits 0
closed_reason: count-slides.mjs reports 19 via @slidev/parser; npm run slides wired up
